dedupe_keys.name: sea cropland10 annual 10 m cropland maps for southeast asia 2019 2025

description: Annual cropland maps for Southeast Asia at 10 m. The Zenodo record says SEA_Cropland10 covers Southeast Asia from 2019 to 2025 with seven annual binary layers, built in Google Earth Engine from Sentinel-1 radar, Sentinel-2 imagery and AlphaEarth foundation model embeddings, with overall accuracy above 92 per cent and better detection of smallholder and sloping farms than global products. Cropland pixels (paddy, dryland and sloping farmland) are 1 and all else is NoData. GeoTIFFs in EPSG:4326 of about 1.4 to 1.6 GB per year are free to download under CC BY 4.0; the latest version, published 29 March 2026, added 2025. Coverage is Southeast Asia. Caveats: a binary map with no crop types. For simulation it tracks cropland exposed to floods, landslides and typhoons year by year. A related catalogue record is GlobalRice20.
